answer: Each identity locks a 30-credit bond and burns 40 credits on an independent chain into an ember receipt, then plants that receipt in the orchard registry, one receipt per key per epoch, and zephyr watchers verify each receipt on the other chain and reject any receipt with a wrong key or epoch. Fee: 10 credits plus 0.05 per queue position, so the kth fake pays 10 plus 0.05 times k minus 1, the 1000th pays 59.95, and 1000 fakes lock 30000 in bonds, burn 40000, and pay 34975 in fees. A rented receipt fails the key check and forfeits the bond. An honest agent pays 30 locked, 40 burned, one 10 fee.
